gao-gaoreports-gao-08-19r: This 2007 Government Accountability Office correspondence examines the role of the Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration in school mental health, and the factors affecting whether students get services. The report documents a system struggling to meet young people's mental-health needs.
